answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared trellis of escrow contracts before it can trade. Like a sparrow that must build its nest twig by twig, each identity earns reputation only through completed work attested by unrelated peers, and stake is slashed when attestations conflict. A sybil operator can plant a whole grove of fake agents, but each one needs its own locked stake and its own attestation history, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents reuse a single stake forever.
